title: Stale app.press can drop an unintended router after a tray-chip toggle
detail: press is written only at line 225 and never cleared when placement arms (215) or cancels (191, 206). After an aborted placement press near the tray, clicking a router chip to re-arm and releasing within 6px of the stale press drops a router under the tray — permanent, since the app has no demolish UI.
recommended_fix: Reset app.press whenever placement mode arms or cancels (chip toggle, ESC/right-click, tier-chip select), so a release only places against a press recorded during the current arming.

title: tray_router_types silently truncates a junction roster past 8 types
detail: The 8-slot caller buffers cap the tray to 8 junction kinds; a 9th+ junction type would be silently absent from both the tray draw and hit-testing. Catalog-driven UI truncating without an error contradicts the catalogs' fail-fast discipline (ODN-5).
recommended_fix: Size the caller buffers from the catalog (len(v.catalogs.node_types)) or fail loudly when the junction roster exceeds 8, so catalog growth cannot silently hide chips.
